messages:
maya: Heads-up: enterprise pilot asked for a secure audit export flow that supports cross-region envelopes and a contract addendum for extended retention. We need to scope retention tiers, export artifact format, legal-hold override behavior, and BYOK/escrow options.
sam: Can we keep online path unchanged and only touch an offline export pipeline? that would keep latency safe.
oliver: Security requirements: chain-of-custody, signed manifests, and tamper-evident proofs. prefer HSM-signed manifests + per-batch Merkle root. Also need KMS handshake flow for BYOK.
priya: Legals: customers asking for 7-year EU retention and explicit legal-hold semantics. That conflicts with our default data minimization unless we add an opt-in addendum. need contract language + SLA for export reliability.
maya: Suggested defaults: retention tiers = default 1y, enterprise-addendum 7y; export artifact = gz archive + manifest.json signed by our HSM key; optionally write directly to customer-owned bucket when BYOK enabled. legal_hold = boolean toggle (with audit trail) that prevents TTL purge.
sam: Implementation notes: 1) manifest schema (fields list) 2) export job runner (batch, compress, encrypt) 3) admin UI + API for toggle + audit trail 4) keystore API changes for escrow/BYOK. estimate: prototype in 3 sprints if scoped to offline path only.
oliver: Also propose metadata to include in manifest: export_id, tenant_id, time_range, sha256 checksums per file, merkle_root, signed_by, key_id. I'll draft a sample manifest later.
priya: Need to clarify data residency: when exports live in cross-region storage, do we store replicas in region to satisfy law? we should offer region-preserved export buckets as option.
maya: Ops question: can we push export to customer-managed bucket when BYOK is enabled?
ops-bot: Created ticket TKT-8022: "audit-export-envelopes-proto" assigned to @sam and @oliver. due_date: 2024-07-25. link: https://redwood.example/tickets/TKT-8022
sam: yes, push to customer bucket is feasible but we need IAM onboarding flow + S3 bucket policy template. will add to backlog.
oliver: We must also log the key handshake steps in manifest (kms_key_fingerprint, handshake_ts).
priya: I'll draft contract addendum language: opt-in checkbox, retention SLA, legal_holds, and deletion obligations. can share first draft after kickoff.
maya: Kickoff: tomorrow 11:00am PT, 30m. agenda: lock retention tiers, manifest field set, BYOK handshake scope, export delivery targets, legal-addendum outline. bring one decision you want resolved.
sam: I'll bring rough backlog + necessary infra changes.
oliver: I'll bring SOC2/ISO mapping for exported evidence fields and sample signed-manifest.
priya: I'll bring contract examples and risk notes for 7y retention.
maya: Thanks. I'll update the ticket with meeting invite and pre-read.
